_comment: Ultimate Texas Hold'em locale file. DO NOT translate keys (left side). Only translate values (right side). Keep every {placeholder} exactly as-is. Never translate the action tokens ('[4x]', '[2x]', '[1x]', '[check]', '[c]', '[fold]', '[f]', '[skip]', '[s]', '[play bet 4x]', ...), the card labels/suits (e.g. 'A♠', 'K♥', '10♦'), the phase labels passed in {phase}, or any numeric chip/bet/payout amounts. The escaped literal '${{...}}' fragments in the rules pay table reproduce a pre-existing display bug verbatim and must be kept exactly (double braces are intentional).

_slots.{hand}: A comma-separated list of card labels, e.g. 'A♠, K♥', or the localized no-cards text
_slots.{phase}: The current phase label token (PRE-ROUND, PRE-FLOP, FLOP, RIVER, SHOWDOWN)
_slots.{actions}: A comma-separated list of bracketed action tokens, e.g. '[play_bet_4x], [check]'
_slots.{available}: A comma-separated list of currently legal bracketed action tokens
_slots.{cards}: A comma-separated list of card labels, e.g. 'Q♣, 7♦, 2♠'
_slots.{name}: A localized poker hand name, inserted verbatim
_slots.{net}: The net chip change for the round (may be negative)

player_prompt.rules:
🎯 ULTIMATE TEXAS HOLD'EM - Single Player vs Dealer

📖 GAME OVERVIEW:
• Wɔde chip {start_chips} hyɛ aseɛ
• Deck a wɔde diiɛ no yɛ 52 ka (2♠-A♠, 2♥-A♥, 2♦-A♦, 2♣-A♣)
• Wɔde diiɛ no yɛ dealer (house)
• Round biara wɔde diiɛ no yɛ Ultimate Texas Hold'em structure: wɔde ANTE ne BLIND bets, wɔde 2 ka a wɔde bɔɔ, wɔde PLAY bets a wɔbetumi ayɛ, wɔde community ka no kyerɛɛ, na wɔde ka no totoo.
• Botaeɛ yɛ sɛ wɔbɛnya chip pɛ (wɔma wo ka no yɛ kɛseɛ), na wɔbɛhwɛ sɛ wɔrenya chip biara (wɔma wo ka no yɛ ketewa).
• Game no bɛba awieɛ wɔma wo chip no yɛ 0 anaa wɔde chip no yɛ 0 wɔ round a wɔde diiɛ no aseɛ (LOSS), anaa wɔde round 1000 wieɛ a wɔwɔ chip (WIN).

💰 BETTING STRUCTURE:
• ANTE: Wɔde bet {ante} wɔ round biara
• BLIND: Wɔde bet {ante} wɔ round biara
• PLAY: Wɔde bet a wɔbetumi ayɛ wɔ gameplay. Wɔde round biara no, wɔbetumi ayɛ sɛ wɔde bet ({ante4} wɔ PRE-FLOP, {ante2} wɔ FLOP, anaa {ante} wɔ RIVER. Wɔbetumi ayɛ sɛ wɔde ka no totoo wɔ river, na wɔde bet biara).

🎴 CARD DEALING:
• Wɔde 2 ka a wɔde bɔɔ (wɔka a wɔde bɔɔ)
• Dealer de 2 ka a wɔde bɔɔ (wɔka a wɔde bɔɔ a wɔnni)
• Wɔde 5 community ka no kyerɛɛ
• Community ka no wɔde kyerɛɛ wɔ phase biara

🏆 DEALER QUALIFICATION:
• Dealer de ka a wɔde bɔɔ a ɛyɛ PAIR (2 ka a wɔde bɔɔ a ɛyɛ rank koro) a wɔde diiɛ, wɔde 2 ka a wɔde bɔɔ ne 5 community ka no.
• Dealer qualification yɛ sɛ wɔde betting outcomes, wɔde kyerɛɛ no pɛ.

🎮 GAME PHASES & ACTIONS:
📋 PRE-FLOP:
  • Actions: [4x] ({ante4}) anaa [check]
  • [4x]: Wɔde bet {ante4} PLAY, wɔde community ka no kyerɛɛ
  • [check]: Wɔde bet biara, wɔde community ka no kyerɛɛ

📋 FLOP:
  • Wɔde 4x bet a wɔde diiɛ: Wɔde [skip] pɛ (wɔde community ka no kyerɛɛ)
  • Wɔde no 4x bet: [2x] ({ante2}) anaa [check]
  • [2x]: Wɔde bet {ante2} PLAY, wɔde community ka no kyerɛɛ
  • [check]: Wɔde bet biara, wɔde community ka no kyerɛɛ

📋 RIVER:
  • Wɔde 4x anaa 2x bet a wɔde diiɛ: Wɔde [skip] pɛ (wɔde showdown)
  • Wɔde no prior PLAY bet: [1x] ({ante}) anaa [fold]
  • [1x]: Wɔde bet {ante} PLAY, wɔde showdown
  • [fold]: Wɔde ka no totoo, wɔde ANTE ne BLIND bets

📋 SHOWDOWN:
  • Wɔde ka no kyerɛɛ ne evaluated
  • Wɔde ka no a ɛyɛ kɛseɛ wɔ 7 ka no (2 ka a wɔde bɔɔ + 5 community ka)
  • Bets wɔde settled sɛ payout rules

💎 BET PAYOUTS:
📊 ANTE BET:
  • Dealer nni qualify: PUSH (bet returned)
  • Dealer qualify & wɔnya: 1:1 payout (bet + winnings)
  • Dealer qualify & wɔhwɛ: Bet lost
  • Tie: PUSH (bet returned)

📊 BLIND BET:
  • Wɔde dealer qualification
  • Wɔnya: Bet returned ne additional payout sɛ wɔka no yɛ kɛseɛ
  • Wɔhwɛ: Bet lost
  • Tie: PUSH (bet returned)

📊 BLIND BET PAY TABLE:
  • Royal Flush: 500:1 (${{self.ante_amount * 500}})
  • Straight Flush: 50:1 (${{self.ante_amount * 50}})
  • Four of a Kind: 10:1 (${{self.ante_amount * 10}})
  • Full House: 3:1 (${{self.ante_amount * 3}})
  • Flush: 3:1 (${{self.ante_amount * 3}})
  • Straight: 1:1 (${{self.ante_amount * 1}})
  • Less than Straight: No additional payout

📊 PLAY BET:
  • Wɔde dealer qualification
  • Direct comparison: Wɔka no a ɛyɛ kɛseɛ vs Dealer's ka no a ɛyɛ kɛseɛ
  • Wɔnya: 1:1 payout (bet + winnings)
  • Wɔhwɛ: Bet lost
  • Tie: PUSH (bet returned)

🎯 POKER HAND RANKINGS (Best to Worst):
  1. Royal Flush: A-K-Q-J-10 a wɔde suit koro
  2. Straight Flush: 5 ka a wɔde suit koro
  3. Four of a Kind: 4 ka a wɔde rank koro
  4. Full House: 3 ka a wɔde rank koro + 2 ka a wɔde rank koro
  5. Flush: 5 ka a wɔde suit koro
  6. Straight: 5 ka a wɔde consecutive
  7. Three of a Kind: 3 ka a wɔde rank koro
  8. Two Pair: 2 pairs a wɔde rank koro
  9. One Pair: 2 ka a wɔde rank koro
  10. High Card: Ka a wɔde rank koro

⌨️  ACTION COMMANDS:
• [4x] anaa [play bet 4x]: Wɔde bet ${{self.ante_amount*4}} PLAY
• [2x] anaa [play bet 2x]: Wɔde bet ${{self.ante_amount*2}} PLAY
• [1x] anaa [play bet 1x]: Wɔde bet ${{self.ante_amount*1}} PLAY
• [check] anaa [c]: Check (no additional bet)
• [fold] anaa [f]: Fold (give up hand)
• [skip] anaa [s]: Skip to next phase (when no action needed)

💡 STRATEGY TIPS:
• Wɔka no a ɛyɛ kɛseɛ (pairs, high cards) often justify 4x bets
• Wɔhwɛ dealer qualification - wɔka no a ɛyɛ ketewa may push if dealer doesn't qualify
• BLIND bet can be very profitable with wɔka no a ɛyɛ kɛseɛ (Royal Flush = 500:1!)
• Wɔhwɛ wɔ chip stack! Wɔde chip no yɛ 0 anaa wɔde chip no yɛ 0 wɔ round a wɔde diiɛ no aseɛ, wɔhwɛ.

⚠️  IMPORTANT NOTES:
• ANTE ne BLIND bets wɔde mandatory every round
• PLAY bets wɔde optional ne strategic
• Wɔhwɛ wɔ input correct action, ne only one action at a time.
